title: Glasses working out well for our morning juice
text: Glasses working out well for our morning juice. I guess these are considered a great design, we have only been using them for a week and we are satisfied...

product_metadata.title: Bormioli Rocco Perugia Small Juice Glass, Set of 6
description: The fine tradition of the Bormioli Rocco Group coincides with the very history of glass: the first glassworks was established in Parma in 1825. The company has always demonstrated a great drive to pioneer innovation: in machinery, materials and design. Over the years it has developed a special talent, that of combining time-honoured craftsmanship and the passion of master glassmakers with modern industrial processes. Bormioli Rocco is the leading company in its sector in Italy and a great ambassador of the Made in Italy label on international markets
